laws.disabled: all provider read/probe/parse counters remain zero
laws.warmQuery: provider-only declaration/metadata polling is zero; actual shared-role config reads remain visible and do not lose compiler authority
laws.warmTransform: no provider reads or admission rebuilds at the whole transform boundary
laws.dependencyChange: capability/publication generation is revoked before reload/query publication; only consumed new bytes may be readmitted
laws.failedReload: old admitted compiler options may survive, old mutable provider capability may not
laws.watchCoverage: all package/declaration/negative-resolution paths require actual client ACK coverage before mutable admission
laws.inFlightPublication: provider/watch lease generations must match before and after native work
laws.isolation: one project change never increments or revokes the other project capability
laws.roleIntersection: shared config/provider paths retain both roles; existing compiler polling/repair is preserved and its actual reads are reported separately

counting: Counters must include actual provider path reads at operation boundaries; direct helper-call counters alone are insufficient.
